name: Aurelia Metals Limited
summary: Aurelia Metals Limited engages in the exploration and production of mineral properties in Australia, China, and South Korea. It explores for gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, and base metal deposits. The company was formerly known as YTC Resources Limited and changed its name to Aurelia Metals Limited in June 2014. Aurelia Metals Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
